description: Experience the quintessential American dessert with this classic New York Baked Cheesecake recipe. Boasting a rich, dense, and incredibly creamy texture, it sits atop a buttery graham cracker crust. This iconic dessert is surprisingly simple to master, promising a perfect slice every time.

instructions.title: Prepare the Crust
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). In a medium bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from oven and let cool slightly while you prepare the filling. Reduce oven temperature to 325°F (160°C).

instructions.title: Mix Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a large bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth and creamy, about 2-3 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed to ensure no lumps remain.

instructions.title: Add Sugars and Dry Ingredients
instructions.text: Gradually add the 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar to the cream cheese mixture, beating until just combined. Mix in the all-purpose flour until smooth. This helps prevent cracking.

instructions.title: Incorporate Wet Ingredients
instructions.text: Stir in the sour cream, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until fully incorporated. Be careful not to overmix at this stage.

instructions.title: Add Eggs Gradually
instructions.text: Add the eggs one at a time, beating on low speed until just combined after each addition. Mix in the extra egg yolk. Do not overbeat the mixture once the eggs are added, as this can introduce too much air and cause cracks during baking.

instructions.title: Bake the Cheesecake
instructions.text: Pour the cheesecake filling over the cooled graham cracker crust. Place the springform pan on a baking sheet. Bake at 325°F (160°C) for 60-70 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center still has a slight jiggle. Turn off the oven, prop the door open slightly, and let the cheesecake cool in the oven for 1 hour. This slow cooling helps prevent cracks.

instructions.title: Chill and Serve
instructions.text: Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool completely on a wire rack at room temperature. Once cool, cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving. This chilling time is crucial for the cheesecake to firm up and develop its classic dense texture.

tips: Ensure all dairy ingredients, especially cream cheese and eggs, are at room temperature. This is a classic American baking technique that ensures a smooth, lump-free batter and even baking.
Do not overmix the cheesecake batter once the eggs are added. Overmixing incorporates too much air, which expands during baking and then collapses, leading to cracks. Mix just until combined.
For best results, chill your New York Baked Cheesecake overnight. This allows the flavors to meld and the texture to become perfectly dense and firm, making for easier slicing and a superior taste.
